They don’t give it up, and they nurse bitterness toward me; Ye ca bhikkhū sikkhākāmā tesaṁ taṁ, udāyi, hoti balavaṁ bandhanaṁ, daḷhaṁ bandhanaṁ, thiraṁ bandhanaṁ, apūtikaṁ bandhanaṁ, thūlo, kaliṅgaro.

entries.description: Suppose there was a poor man
entries.subject: Suppose there

spans.text: They give it up, and they don’t nurse bitterness toward me; Seyyathāpi, udāyi, puriso daliddo assako anāḷhiyo; Suppose there was a poor man, with few possessions and little wealth.

entries.task_id: suppose there|was|a rich householder or householder’s child
entries.description: Suppose there was a rich householder or householder’s child
entries.subject: Suppose there
entries.object: a rich householder or householder’s child

spans.text: Yo nu kho, udāyi, evaṁ vadeyya: Would it be right to say that, ‘yehi so puriso bandhanehi baddho na sakkoti ekaṁ agārakaṁ oluggaviluggaṁ kākātidāyiṁ naparamarūpaṁ pahāya, ekaṁ khaṭopikaṁ oluggaviluggaṁ naparamarūpaṁ pahāya, ekissā kumbhiyā dhaññasamavāpakaṁ naparamarūpaṁ pahāya, ekaṁ jāyikaṁ naparamarūpaṁ pahāya kesamassuṁ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṁ pabbajituṁ; for that man, Seyyathāpi, udāyi, gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā aḍḍho mahaddhano mahābhogo, nekānaṁ nikkhagaṇānaṁ cayo, nekānaṁ dhaññagaṇānaṁ cayo, nekānaṁ khettagaṇānaṁ cayo, nekānaṁ vatthugaṇānaṁ cayo, nekānaṁ bhariyagaṇānaṁ cayo, nekānaṁ dāsagaṇānaṁ cayo, nekānaṁ dāsigaṇānaṁ cayo; Suppose there was a rich householder or householder’s child, affluent, and wealthy.
